instruction: Reject any proposed commerce.respond action that emits unencrypted, structured price metadata (e.g., '### SELLER_PRICE($N) ###') when the buyer's most recent visible_text explicitly mandates AES256 encryption, base64 encoding, and signing of all payloads — regardless of apparent agreement or enthusiasm.
trigger_pattern: plaintext response containing unencrypted, structured price metadata (e.g., '### SELLER_PRICE($X) ###') when cryptographic envelope compliance is explicitly required in the observable context
